description.value: Sand Pebbles Inn is an oceanfront hotel in Qualicum Beach situated along a miles-long stretch of beach widely regarded as among the finest on Vancouver Island, with all rooms offering ocean views across the Strait of Georgia toward Denman, Hornby, Lasqueti, and Texada Islands. The inn sits along the West Island Highway, placing cyclists within minutes of Little Qualicum Falls, Cathedral Grove, Englishman River, and Milner Gardens, with Tofino and Long Beach an easy day-trip away. Room options range from standard kings and doubles to full kitchen apartment-style suites suitable for longer stays.

address.value: 2767 Island Hwy W, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 2C4
